method: After freezing the fresh image-only readings, compare with pre-correction working readings, then return to native scan crops. This is same-reader adjudication.

decisions.evidence: Native imprint crop prints one yod between tet and final nun.
The scan prints a vav between lamed and he in the opening Psalm verse.
The scan prints alef immediately followed by tav, without a vav, in Psalm145:5.
A word space, not a maqqef, separates these words in Psalm145:21.
The Psalm25:6 preface has a word space, not a maqqef.
A short horizontal maqqef is visible between yod and bet in the first Kaddish paragraph.
Enlarged kingdom line shows vav; the blind reading omitted it.
Printed maqqef joins the words across a physical line wrap; the space in the blind capture reflects wrapping.
The isolated oblique ink mark left of אינגליש may be punctuation or a print blemish. Do not assert a period without clearer evidence.

other_checks: Hebrew title, subtitle, address and year agree apart from the surname difference and undecided terminal mark.
All three opening English rubrics and embedded Hebrew cues agree with the image-only capture.
Opening heading, Psalm citation, Ashrei prelude, remaining Psalm tokens, postlude, Kaddish preface/rubrics and all printed Kaddish tokens/pointing compared within scope.
Hebrew printed numeral ג confirmed on s8; the opening s6 has no numeral.
Psalm145:9 continuation is verified across s6→s8; no opening text is omitted.
unresolved: Possible terminal mark after אינגליש on s2.
No independent-person proofreading claimed; English facing pages and the rest of the book remain outside this batch.
